Container.Name: fribourg-events-digest
Container.Overview: Weekly Fribourg & Bern event digest. Fetches events from insitu.live, bka.ch and eventfrog.ch, deduplicates them, and sends a chronological 14-day digest to Telegram every Monday at 07:00 Europe/Zurich. The only HTTP surface is Actuator health/info.
Container.Description: Fetches events from insitu.live, bka.ch and eventfrog.ch, deduplicates them, and sends a chronological 14-day digest to Telegram every Monday at 07:00 Europe/Zurich.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Actuator health/info. Change the host port if 8080 is taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database directory (create it if it does not exist).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID that owns the data folder. Unraid default is 99 (nobody); match your share owner.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID that owns the data folder. Unraid default is 100 (users); match your share owner.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone; keep in sync with DIGEST_ZONE.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: SQLite file inside the mounted /data volume. Do not point it outside /data.

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Bot API token from @BotFather. Required unless DIGEST_DRY_RUN=true.

Config.Name: Telegram chat id
Config.Description: Target chat id (a private chat by default). Required unless DIGEST_DRY_RUN=true.

Config.Name: Cron
Config.Description: Spring cron expression. Default: Mondays 07:00 in DIGEST_ZONE.

Config.Name: Digest zone
Config.Description: Zone for the window, day grouping and cron.

Config.Name: Window days
Config.Description: Fetch/selection window in local days.

Config.Name: Run on startup
Config.Description: Run once when the container starts. Leave true for the first deploy, then switch to false.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: Render and log the digest without sending to Telegram.

Config.Name: Send failure notice
Config.Description: Send a short notice when every source fails instead of staying silent.

Config.Name: Show merged count
Config.Description: Append the cross-source dedup count to the digest footer.

Config.Name: Telegram part limit
Config.Description: Maximum characters per Telegram message part (Telegram hard limit is 4096).

Config.Name: Rate limit per second
Config.Description: Per-host request rate for scraped sources. Keep at 1 unless the spec changes.

Config.Name: Max requests per run
Config.Description: Per-source request budget. Keep at 60 unless the spec changes.

Config.Name: HTTP timeout
Config.Description: Outbound API and Telegram timeout.

Config.Name: Headless browser
Config.Description: Run Chromium headless. Only change for debugging on a machine with a display.

Config.Name: insitu enabled
Config.Description: Read insitu.live (canton Fribourg).

Config.Name: bka enabled
Config.Description: Read bka.ch (canton Bern).

Config.Name: eventfrog enabled
Config.Description: Read eventfrog.ch city pages (Fribourg and Bern).

Config.Name: Dedup title threshold
Config.Description: Jaro-Winkler title score required for a fuzzy merge.

Config.Name: Dedup venue threshold
Config.Description: Jaro-Winkler venue score required when both sides have a venue.

Config.Name: Dedup date window
Config.Description: Maximum day difference between the first occurrences of two candidates.
